summary: Moderate: ruby security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
Ruby is an extensible, interpreted, object-oriented, scripting language. It has features to process text files and to perform system management tasks.

Security Fix(es):

* ruby: double free issue in regular expression parser (CVE-2026-89078)

* ruby: integer overflow issue in regular expression compiler (CVE-2026-93577)

* ruby: integer overflow issue in CI/CD regular expression compiler (CVE-2026-97229)

* ruby: integer overflow issue in regular expression compiler (CVE-2026-110264)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* ruby: Rebase to the latest Ruby 3.3 release [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-300972)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
